liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Phil Bottleneck Solo** (2 reviews): Reviewer played the Rhythm Devils into Phil bottleneck into Other One sequence on the radio, drawing appreciative calls; Reviewer singles out Phil's bottleneck solo as a standout and calls the show unusually intimate and off the beaten track [13][16]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Listed among the reviewer's highlights, along with Minglewood, Althea, Man Smart and Spoonful [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Other One especially hot, with Jerry playing strongly across both sets [7]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Wharf Rat as a really hot performance [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Far From Me**: back after 109 archived shows (404 days) [19]
- **The Other One tease**: back after 466 archived shows (2552 days); rare: 7 archived performances [19]
- **Rhythm Devils**: back after 124 archived shows (425 days); rare: 4 archived performances [19]
- **Phil Bottleneck Solo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Spoonful [19]

## The recordings

- **gd81-10-15.aud-michael-the-belgian.unknown.25829.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 129 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording feels like the band playing in your garage, very close and intimate; Recording is quite acceptable, and the audience sounds responsive, with a loud roar greeting Althea [11][15]
- **gd1981-10-15.beyer.stankiewicz.126148.flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 132 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1981-10-15.aud.michel.79933.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 128 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd81-10-15.aud.agan.1406.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 129 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- Unadvertised secret show in a small bar; about 15 US fans on tour sat on stage with the band [9]
- Melkweg's rear balcony sits roughly 20 feet from the stage; the room is tiny and about 15 people attended [13]
- During Alabama Getaway, people can be seen sitting on stage by Brent's side; audience noise suggests about 100 people [14]
- Reviewer calls the show ragged but ultimately right, an evening of sloppy, inspired fun [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-10-15.aud-michael-the-belgian.unknown.25829.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser-pro-direction> New Marantz cass.rec [1]
- **gd1981-10-15.beyer.stankiewicz.126148.flac1644**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz and Andrew F; source: AUD: 2x Beyer M-88 > Sony TC-D5, set up on rail of the mezzanine. [4]. Also: Recorded by Richie, using Beyer 88 microphones [18]
- **gd1981-10-15.aud.michel.79933.sbeok.flac16**: source: One Shure and one Senheiser > Marantz lookalike Sony TC-D5 > MAC [2]
- **gd81-10-15.aud.agan.1406.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
